nl_main_wall.blurb: The Main Wall is the principal cliff at Holyrood, at the head of Conception Bay on the Avalon Peninsula. Ten routes, nearly all of them traditionally protected, climb clean granite slab with a crack system to take gear. Grades run from an easy 5.4 up to a single 5.10, with the bulk between 5.6 and 5.9, which makes it a friendly place for climbers learning to place gear. A couple of routes run several pitches. It sits a little inland, so it can warm up sooner in spring and stay usable later in autumn than the coast.
